Case reference: 2006011699.CaseDesc: Justin Pollari is from St. Joseph Island, Ontario, and was last seen on Friday, December 7, 2001. He is known to be an avid skateboarder and may frequent areas where this sport is practised.

Hair: Blonde, Sometimes worn in a "Mohawk" style
Jewelry: Wood, Nametag with the inscription of "Woody"

Case reference: 2014005069.CaseDesc: On February 27, 2008, at approximately 3:00 p.m., Kien Hua was seen for the last time by his friend in Toronto, Ontario. Kien had told his friend that he was going to borrow his parents' car and was leaving town for a couple of days. On March 4, 2008, his parents' vehicle was found abandoned in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2006002199.CaseDesc: On September 23, 1994, this Caucasian male, was found in a field on the south side of the Rogers Centre (formerly known as the SkyDome) at the far end of Rees Street in Toronto. His post-mortem length was approximately 6’2" and he weighed 162lbs, however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

Teeth: Missing several teeth; had a great deal of restorative work done in the past with multiple silver-amalgam restorations

Case reference: 2007003099.CaseDesc: Christina Calayca was on a camping trip with friends at Rainbow Falls Provincial Park near Schreiber, Ontario. At approximately 6:30 a.m. on 6 August 2007, Christina informed a colleague of her intention to go jogging and was last seen on a roadway in the park's campground, from which she did not return. A comprehensive search was conducted by the Ontario Provincial Police, both on the ground and in the air, but unfortunately Christina was not located.

Case reference: 2018063244.CaseDesc: On June 9, 2001, at approximately 11:00 a.m., Marilyn Payne was seen for the last time when she left the hostel she was staying at.

Case reference: 2006003399.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2001, this male, was found in a sewer at 470 Lansdowne Avenue in Toronto. His ancestry is Caucasian, possibly Egyptian or mixed African/Caucasian. He had previous surgery of his left forearm, which had involved the implant of surgical plates. The numbers visible on the surgical plates could not be traced to a specific individual, however, it was determined that the lot was released some time after May 25, 1994. A MacDonald’s name tag with the name "Raymond" was found in the sewer, which may or may not be related to this individual.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Teeth were stained, which suggests he may have been a smoker,  his upper central incisors were also missing
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Hip, recent fracture of left hip

Case reference: 2015020614.CaseDesc: On April 24, 2015, at approximately 4:00 p.m., Markmiller Kwesiga was seen for the last time near Finch Avenue and Keele Street in Toronto, Ontario.

Hat: Grey, Toque, Toque with white lettering on the front
Shoes: Brown, Light brown with black sole

Case reference: 2014005158.CaseDesc: Frederick Lagrelle was last seen on April 12, 1997 in the area of the Sunchild and O’Chiese First Nations in Alberta. It is possible he was seen in Rocky Mountain House, Alberta days after. He was known to walk with a cane and wear a leg/knee brace. Frederick was described by family as having an intellectual disability as a result of a past accident.

Case reference: 2014004578.CaseDesc: Donald Tardif was last seen on August 7, 2003, on Lac Devenyns in the municipality of St-Michel-des-Saints, Québec. Donald fell from his 14-foot motorboat and has never been seen since.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Calf, Tibia and fibula fragments

Case reference: 2016061151.CaseDesc: On April 29, 2014, a male was recovered from a reservoir behind Energy Ottawa, building #511 at 4 Booth Street, Ottawa. His appendix and gallbladder are present. It is believed that he had been in the water for a few days to a few months.

Hair: Brown, Medium length; balding and face stuble
Teeth: Extensive amount of dental work including root canal, crowns, posts and composite resin fillings.
Other: Red, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 2 disposable lighters
cigarettes in a white opaque plastic container
a hand drawn map of the Richmond Rd/Churchill Ave area, drawn on a torn off cover of a notepad
folding knife with built in nail file and opener on a ring
3 keys (SM "ILCO" key, Curtis "SC1" & Oscar "WR3" house keys)

Case reference: 2014005517.CaseDesc:
At the time of her disappearance, Amber Guiboche was living in the north end of Winnipeg with her boyfriend and his family. Amber had been leading a high-risk lifestyle.

Amber spent the evening of November 10th, 2010 socializing with friends. Later that evening she went to a friend’s residence on Bushnell St. She left there alone at around 11:45 p.m., and walked to the intersection of Isabel Street and William Ave.  

She was picked up there shortly after by a man driving a burgundy pickup truck. The truck was described as an older, burgundy Chevrolet Silverado, extended cab, short box with a “4x4” decal toward the rear of the box. 

The truck was last seen traveling southbound on Isabel St. It was captured on video in the area in which she was last seen.

Images of this truck and a forensic artist’s sketch of the driver have been made available.

Case reference: 2006014899.CaseDesc: Robert Commu was last seen at his residence in South Dumfries Township, Ontario on March 31, 1996. At 7:00 p.m. on this date, a neighbour went to the residence and found the front door open and his compact disc player repeatedly playing the same song. Robert had been despondent over a failed relationship and an illness in the family. He has not contacted any family members or friends since his disappearance.

Jacket: Leather, Black, White, Red Maple leaf on the back
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, lion with wings

Case reference: 2014002875.CaseDesc: Edmond Belliveau was last seen on Oct 1, 1985, in Saint John, New Brunswick.

Case reference: 2012020147.CaseDesc: On March 25, 1996, the skeletal remains of a man were found near the Upper Levels Highway in West Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had recovered from severe injuries to his right arm and leg. He also had a fractured skull, nose and ribs. These injuries were likely a result of a single major accident. It is estimated that he may have died several months prior to the discovery of his remains.

Jacket: Corduroy, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 3/4 length coat with fleece
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Side Of Head, Recent fracture to the left temporal bone above the left ear
Nose, Old nasal fracture with visible deformity
Deformity: Shoulders, Old injury; no indication of which shoulder

Case reference: 2013000083.CaseDesc: On December 4, 1999, Jean-René Duguay was seen for the last time when he was seen jumping off the Lachapelle Bridge in Montreal, Quebec. Jean-René’s body was never found.

Case reference: 2014006037.CaseDesc: On the evening of March 21, 2013, Bruno Pouliot was last seen in a pharmacy located in Saint-Pierre-de-l’île-d’Orléans, Québec. Bruno lived in the Donnacona, Quebec area and was known to go snowshoeing on the frozen St. Lawrence River.  Family members have reasons to be concerned about his well-being.

Case reference: 2014002017.CaseDesc: On September 1, 1997, Marc Dionne was seen for the last time as he was leaving the Harley Pub in the Cap-de-la-Madeleine area of Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Marc was seen entering into a small white vehicle as the passenger. Marc was reported missing on the next day and there has been no news from him since.

Case reference: 2012020017.CaseDesc: Stephen Begg was reported missing February 16, 2011.  Stephen struggled with alcoholism and depression.

Case reference: 2014002407.CaseDesc: On  June 27, 1973, Robert Scott Ellis and a friend went fishing on Reed Lake in Manitoba. They left in the morning around 9:30 a.m. and fished until about 6:00 p.m. when they decided to return home. As the day progressed, the weather deteriorated and the water became quite rough. They began to take on water over the sides of the canoe. Despite the progress they were making, the canoe was finally rolled over by a wave. Both men held on to the canoe for hours, but Robert eventually got tired and let go.  When the friend finally reached shore, he reported the incident. A drag and dive operation was launched, but the results were negative. It is presumed that Robert drowned.

Case reference: 2016061381.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1970 a Caucasian male was found in the ravine just north of Beechwood Ave. The ravine was located 300 yards south of the Leaside Bridge and approximately 100 yards east of the Don River.

Other: Rifle - Winchester Model 94 30-30 calibre, with a black and white rifle case

Case reference: 2008003399.CaseDesc: William Smith was last seen operating a large boat leaving Port Rowan, Ontario at approximately 5:30 pm on June 23, 1983. The boat was seen heading out to the north channel, which would lead into Lake Erie. The boat is described as a white, 31 foot, 1977 Bertram hardtop cruiser with a flying bridge. The hull VIN number is 3121641B and the boat had twin Mercruiser 330 hp engines.

Case reference: 2018063272.CaseDesc: On February 13, 2002, Wayne McMahon was seen for the last time by his building's superintendent in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2024031130.CaseDesc: On June 16, 2024, Mark Bullock was last seen in Jasper, Alberta.  Mark was reported to be traveling to Jasper with a friend.

Case reference: 2020020791.CaseDesc: On May 12, 2020, David was supposed to cross into Tucson, Arizona from Nogales, Mexico. Unfortunately, he has not been heard from since. Last contact was made around midnight between May 12 and 13, 2020.

Scar: Upper Back, Stab wound scar (51 mm)

Case reference: 2006020499.CaseDesc: Theodore Piekarz was initially reported missing in 1978. He was planning a trip to British Columbia and was last seen at the Kirkland Lake Train Station in October 1986. Theodore may be experiencing mental health challenges, including suicidal tendencies.

Mark: Nose, Mole on the right side of his nose

Case reference: 2013000033.CaseDesc: Bernard Deromer was last seen at the metro station Berri-UQAM (University of Quebec in Montreal) on June 5, 1982 in Montreal, Quebec. Bernard is blind and walks with a white cane. He may have been approached by a religious sect.

Teeth: Other, Upper front tooth obliquely broken
Chain: worn around neck, with several medals
Other: blind and walks with a white cane
Scar: Right Ear, near the right ear

Case reference: 2014001591.CaseDesc: On September 5, 1997, Gordon Mertz was seen for the last time at the Department of Fisheries and Oceans (DFO) on East White Hills road in St. John's, Newfoundland. Gordon worked as a Fisheries Scientist, and records show that he logged off of his computer and left the building shortly after 5:15 p.m.

Case reference: 2006010899.CaseDesc: Larry Zink left his home in Delavan, Wisconsin, USA. Family members have indicated that he may have been despondent.  In October 1995, Larry's vehicle was located unoccupied in a gravel pit 65 km north of Pickle Lake, Ontario.  He hasn't been seen since.

Teeth: False, Upper teeth and partial bottom teeth - front bottom teeth are his own

Case reference: 2012020034.CaseDesc: The Edmonton Police Service is seeking assistance in locating Dylan Steven Koshman. He was last seen on October 12, 2008 on the south side of Edmonton.

Case reference: 2014004565.CaseDesc: On December 1, 2004, Jack Day left Fort McMurray, Alberta, for an unknown destination. On December 4, 2004, Jack's abandoned vehicle was discovered at Chrystina Lake Provincial Recreational area near Swan Hills, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014005578.CaseDesc: Alexander Calder was last seen on August 27, 1980, in Edmonton, Alberta. Alexander was transient in nature and frequented social service agencies in downtown Edmonton. He was also known to frequent Edmonton's River Valley Walterdale neighbourhood and is described as having cognitive impairment.

Case reference: 2017021464.CaseDesc: Since April 14, 2017, Deborah Ann Hutchinson's family has not seen or heard from her. Deborah's vehicle, a 2005 white Kia Magentis, was later located in the Cossitt Heights area of Sydney, Nova Scotia.

Case reference: 2012020136.CaseDesc: Guy Verdon has been missing since March 24, 2010 from Charlemagne, Quebec. On that day, he went to visit his daughter’s home and later left her residence around 7:00 p.m. and was never seen again. Guy's associate, François Robillard also disappeared around the same time.

Teeth: False, Had partials, top and bottom
Chain: Gold, Gold, Pendant, medallion of the Holy Virgin
Watch: Gold, Gold, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, "Raymond Weil" brand, two-tone bracelet
Amputation: Left Middle Finger, Tip of middle finger amputated

Case reference: 2014005921.CaseDesc: On June 19, 2012, at approximately noon, Diane Bonneau was seen for the last time at her residence in Saint-Félicien, Quebec. Diane hasn’t been seen and we haven’t heard from her since.

Case reference: 2013000024.CaseDesc: Susan Dawson lived with and worked for Terry Murphy for approximately 3 weeks prior to her disappearance. She was last seen in the late hours of 12 November 1985 at a gathering at Terry's home in Neville, Saskatchewan.  On November 14, at approximately 11:55 a.m., a massive explosion occurred at Terry's home. There was no indication that Susan was in the house at the time of the explosion. Investigators suspect foul play and that Terry was somehow involved in Susan's disappearance.

Case reference: 2014006767.CaseDesc: On April 22, 2014, Guo Ding was seen for the last time when he was discharged from the Mount Sinai Hospital in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002218.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1977, Arthur Roy was seen for the last time, at approximately 1400hrs, when he left his home on foot in North Bay, Ontario. Arthur was suffering from a mental illness and was believed to be senile due to old age.

Case reference: 2014005326.CaseDesc: On June 2, 1972, Edmonton Police Service members found a purse and identification belonging to Eunice Antoniuk on the walkway of the High Level Bridge in Edmonton, Alberta. A note addressed to her family was found within the purse. All police searches were negative and Eunice has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2008005999.CaseDesc: On September 8, 1978, Brian McLean and his co-worker, Russell Thomas, were commercial fishing at their camp on MacDowell Lake, near MacDowell Lake First Nation Territory. Russell advised that they left in separate boats to lift nets. He went to the west side of the lake and pulled four nets, then to the east side of the lake and lifted two more nets. He then realized that Brian was not there. Russell headed back towards the camp and found Brian's boat washed up against the shore approximately three or four hundred metres from the camp. The motor was in forward gear with the throttle off, and the paddle was missing from the boat. MacDowell Lake is 90 "air miles" north of Red Lake, and is accessible only by air. The area was searched, and the lake was dragged, but Brian McLean has not been found.

Pants: Oilskin, Green, Coveralls with blue suspenders
Amputation: Right Foot, all toes except big toe left

Case reference: 2014005452.CaseDesc: Albert Morris Hopkins departed his cabin on Sunday, November 2, 1975, to go fishing on Lake Athapapuskow in Manitoba. When he failed to return three days later, he was reported missing. Soon thereafter, on November 6th, his boat was located overturned banging against rocks. Despite intensive boat patrols and dragging operations, Albert has not been found. Foul play is not suspected, and it is assumed that he drowned.

Case reference: 2026021266.CaseDesc: Denise Williams has not been seen or heard from since she was reported missing by family members in Inverness, Nova Scotia on April 15, 2026. Denise last indicated that she was going to Cheticamp, Nova Scotia. Denise’s vehicle, a rented Nissan Sentra, was later located at the Parks Canada Visitor Centre near the Acadian Trail in Cape Breton Highlands National Park. GPS confirmed that her vehicle had been parked there since April 15. Despite the use of GSAR and helicopter searches, Denise has not been found. Denise is originally from Australia.

Hat: Light Blue, text "Antarctica", written on the front
Tattoo: Left Ankle, Black cat arching it's back

Case reference: 2014005573.CaseDesc: In November/December 1976, Vernon Loiselle was visiting family in an Edmonton, Alberta hospital. Vernon left the hospital and hasn't been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005121.CaseDesc: On May 10, 2008, Marie Claude Chrétien spent part of the evening at home building a campfire with neighbours in Cantley, Quebec. She was last seen by her next-door neighbour at around 11:30 p.m. No one has had any contact with her since and Marie Claude left no message or clue as to her whereabouts.

Teeth: False, Upper dental prosthetic and natural lower teeth

Case reference: 2013000028.CaseDesc: Leonette Purcell has not been seen or heard from since she disappeared on December 16, 2004, from her Grand Lake home situated near the Halifax International Airport, in Nova Scotia. The circumstances of Leonette's disappearance are suspicious and foul play is suspected.

Case reference: 2014002108.CaseDesc: On August 18, 1978, Craig Waldum took part in a canoeing expedition along the Nelson River in Gillam, Manitoba, with seven other people. He was one of two guides on the trip. Three members of the group were on the riverbank. They were guiding the second canoe to shore with a rope. The remaining five members, including Craig, were in the second canoe. While guiding the canoe to shore, they gave the rope some slack. This caused the bow of the canoe to turn out into the current and tip over. Those on the shore were unable to hold onto the rope because of the strength of the current and the canoe was swept downstream. Craig held onto the canoe for a couple of hours, and then he was seen to let go. He slipped under the water and did not resurface. His remains have not been recovered.

Case reference: 2014005052.CaseDesc: On March 28, 2007, Ohanes Melkon was last seen when he departed his residence located in Innisfail, Alberta to go purchase food.

Case reference: 2012020140.CaseDesc: Melina Martin of Sainte-Sabine, Quebec was last seen on January 23, 2005 at 1:30 p.m. in the Roch-Bourbonnais park in Farnham, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014002313.CaseDesc: On April 5, 1986 Donald Smith was observed in the area of the Whirlpool Bridge in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance Donald was despondent and had trouble walking due to arthritis.

Teeth: False, Upper dentures and missing teeth
Amputation: Left Index Finger, Tip of left index missing

Case reference: 2020008580.CaseDesc: On December 14, 1973, at approximately 8:30 am, Teresa Desa was seen for the last time at her family home in Toronto, Ontario. There is a possibility that Teresa ran away with the family’s tenant, Amavel Santos.

Coat: Brown, Light brown with white trim

Case reference: 2025024697.CaseDesc: On May 15, 2025, the Canadian Coast Guard Search and Rescue team found a sailboat belonging to Amber Nitchman washed up on the shore near 5362 Bayshore Road in Nanaimo, British Columbia.  Amber was a novice sailor who may have fallen overboard while operating the vessel.

Scar: Shoulders, Branding scar on the shoulder, unknown whether left or right.
Tattoo: Unknown, Feather on foot, unknown whether left or right

Case reference: 2012020032.CaseDesc: Lorilee Francis was last known to be in Grande Prairie, Alberta. She has not been heard from by family or friends since approximately October of 2007.

Case reference: 2024032467.CaseDesc: Brian Deveau of no fixed address was reported missing to police by his sister from Moncton, New Brunswick. Brian's last contact was with the RCMP on May 14, 2024. Nobody has seen or heard from Brian since that time and it is unusual for him to not be in contact with his sister. He is known for living a transient lifestyle, all locally searched hospitals and shelters resulted in a negative return and Brian's phone has been disconnected.

Hair: Black, Short, Full beard, thick moustache
Tattoo: Left Side Of Neck, Demon skull with Indian headdress
Right Side Of Neck, Skull with crown, wings "Est '87"
Right Wrist, Rose heart banner, robin with tribal flames
Left Wrist, Tribal red star, green tribal on top

Case reference: 2014001072.CaseDesc: On July 19 1984, the body of a male believed to be between the ages of 18-29 was found in the waters of the Fraser River near Boston Bar, British Columbia. He had some crowding on his upper teeth and no tattoos or obvious scars. It is believed he was deceased for a few months prior to his remains being recovered.

Case reference: 2008018099.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1974, at approximately 8:15 hours, Douglas Henderson and Alexander Korecki were canoeing in a 14 foot fiberglass canoe close to the shore in the area of Depot Harbor, Big Sound, in Georgian Bay. The canoe capsized approximately 500 feet away from the campsite.

Case reference: 2014002717.CaseDesc: Giuseppe Colina was last seen on March 15, 1979, in Montreal, Quebec. On that day, Giuseppe left his residence early to go to work. He told his co-workers he was leaving early because he had things to do and did not complete his work day.

Case reference: 2014005683.CaseDesc: Lorie MacDougall was last seen on October 11, 2011, leaving her residence in St.Catharines, Ontario.  Shortly after this, Lorie’s vehicle was located abandoned in a parking lot near Niagara Glen Centre in Niagara Falls, Ontario.  At this time Lorie was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2014001761.CaseDesc: Henrietta Mille is originally from Nain, Newfoundland and had been living in St. John’s, Newfoundland for quite some time before her disappearance. Henrietta was known to frequent the clubs in the St. John’s downtown area. Her keys, purse and other belongings were found at the Key Club.

Case reference: 2024002229.CaseDesc: On December 23, 2023, Taron Stepanyan was seen by his wife, when he left their residence and never returned. He was then reported as missing on January 14, 2024 to the Toronto Police Service.

Mark: Torso (Back), Loonie size mole on the upper back near the spine
Tattoo: Chest, Lion, from the shoulder to the chest

Case reference: 2014002370.CaseDesc: On June 16, 1997, at approximately 4:30pm, Kelvin Zdarski and two friends left Dauphin, Manitoba and drove to a cabin near Waterhen, Manitoba. During the evening there was an argument between the men. Kelvin left the cabin and never returned. The men looked for him on their way back to Dauphin but did not see him. On June 17, around 7:30am, a man fitting Kelvin's description was seen walking on a local road. An extensive search by land, air and water proved unsuccessful. Kelvin did not take his wallet, money or identification with him and had no means of transportation.

Scar: Left Calf, 1 inch long, back of calf

Case reference: 2021056970.CaseDesc: On November 12, 1998, the remains of an unidentified woman were recovered from North West Connoire in Newfoundland. The woman had a complete fusion of the proximal and intermediate phalanges of her right ring finger. This fusion would have rendered her joint completely immobilized.

Case reference: 2023054349.CaseDesc: On October 2, 2023, Kyrylo Yeltsov was reported missing from the IUSMM - Pavillon Bédard in the Mercier-Hochelaga-Maisonneuve District of Montréal, Québec. He hasn't spoken to his mother or any of his friends since, and he's never returned to the hospital. Kyrylo is originally from Ukraine and was feeling despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Hair: Black, Bald, Black hair, currently bald

Case reference: 2013000027.CaseDesc: Nancy Joanne Forbes has not been seen or heard from since November 7, 2006. Nancy was last seen at a bus stop on her way to a job interview in the Burnside Industrial Park in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia.

Case reference: 2012020113.CaseDesc: On September 11, 2004, Sylvie Menard was reported missing in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Sylvie was last seen at approximately 1:00 p.m. in a licensed establishment located at the intersection of 3rd Row and Highway 359 (Main Street) in Saint-Luc-de-Vincennes, Quebec.

Case reference: 2017021635.CaseDesc: Kevin Sadownyk was last seen on April 24, 2017 in Okotoks, Alberta. Kevin’s truck was found abandoned just outside of Banff, Alberta the next day. Kevin was reported missing by his family and has not been seen since.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Spray Gun and text "RHYS Kolby"

Case reference: 2014006281.CaseDesc: Henri-Joel Anvire's original nationality is from the Ivory Coast, and he relocated to Ottawa, Ontario at the age of 11.  He has resided in Ottawa until his disappearance in 2009.  In October 2009, Henri-Joel informed his employer that he was going to Montreal, Quebec, and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014003990.CaseDesc: On November 28, 1978, Yashar Ilkay and his wife went to bed for the night. When Yashar’s wife woke up the following morning, her husband was no longer in the residence. Yashar left his residence without his glasses, dentures and money. Yashar was last seen in the downtown Moncton, New Brunswick area.

Shirt: brown, white and blue long sleeve shirt

Case reference: 2014006098.CaseDesc: On March 12, 2012, Marc Ménard left Quebec to travel to Mexico by car with his dog. When returning home on March 14, 2013, he was denied entry to the United States at the US Customs in Nuevo Laredo, Mexico because his dog was carrying ticks. Therefore, he stayed in Mexico and has not been seen since. His vehicle and his dog were recovered after having been stolen. The individuals interviewed for the vehicle theft provided no information into Marc's disappearance.

Case reference: 2013000021.CaseDesc: Bones of a right foot with its sock and shoe were found along the bank of the Ottawa river in Gatineau, Quebec.

Case reference: 2024011240.CaseDesc: Melanie Lapish was last seen on February 26, 2024, in the town of Fort Frances, Ontario. Melanie has ties to the Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario area.

Tattoo: Lower Back, Tribal tattoo with butterfly, black and white, 102 mm (4 inches)

Case reference: 2014006219.CaseDesc: On the night of the 17 to 18 August 2013, Benoit Germain was seen for the last time while he was attending a truck show in Baie-du-Febvre, Quebec. His car was found abandoned a few days later on a trail to a wooded area north of La Tuque, Quebec. Benoit has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003900.CaseDesc: On December 8, 1977 at approximately 3 p.m., Ronald Foucault left his father’s business located in the city of Blainville, Quebec and told his father he had to travel to Texas, in the United States for work. There has been no news from Ronald since this time and it is impossible to confirm his arrival in the United States. In 1979, some of his belongings were found near the Dorval airport in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2015066998.CaseDesc: Yvon Shawn Guignard relocated to the northern part of Manitoba during the summer of 2015 in pursuit of employment opportunities, with a particular interest in Churchill, Manitoba and the Northwest Territories. While in Thompson, he adopted a transient lifestyle, living in his vehicle and developing friendships within the homeless community. Yvon was last seen on November 28, 2015, at around 6:45 a.m. A number of attempts to give away his personal vehicle were made by him just prior to his disappearance. The vehicle was located at the time he was reported missing. According to his family, he suffers from schizophrenia and has a history of not taking his prescription medication. Yvon has been known to travel to undisclosed locations within the country and act secretive with family as to his whereabouts.

Case reference: 2014004550.CaseDesc: On November 18, 2004, David Creaser was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta.

Tattoo: Shoulders, One side features a tigre, and the other, a dragon

Case reference: 2014004419.CaseDesc: Holly Painter was initially reported as a missing person on June 26, 1995. On that evening, two friends of Holly's reported that they were at her residence when an argument broke out between Holly and one of the friends. They said that Holly assaulted that friend; the other friend then took Holly from the residence. All 3 of them left in the second friend's vehicle, with him driving. He reported that he intended to take Holly to her parents' residence, however, while making a left turn at an intersection, she jumped out of the vehicle and ran off.

Case reference: 2023017319.CaseDesc: On April 8th, 2017 Kurt Beehler was last observed in the area of the Rainbow Bridge, Niagara Falls, New York. At the time of his disappearance, Kurt was despondent.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, Cross on inside of forearm

Case reference: 2014005826.CaseDesc: On June 4, 2012, the Banff RCMP were contacted by a tour company to report that Duc Dao and his son, Nguyen Dao of Vietnam did not arrive to board their bus at the scheduled time.  The two men had been staying at the Banff International Hotel and there were no personal items left in their room. The two men were due to fly back to Vietnam two days later. However, they did not board their scheduled flight and it is unknown if they returned to Vietnam.

Case reference: 1996006630.CaseDesc: Adam, Mitchell and Trevor O'Brien have been reported missing since November 9, 1996 from Mount Pearl, Newfoundland & Labrador. The three brothers may be in the company of their father.

Case reference: 2013000055.CaseDesc: Ronald Donelle has been missing since November 16, 2001 from the Pierrefonds-Roxboro district in Montreal, Quebec. Ronald was last seen dropping off his ex-wife in front of her home in his vehicle, a 4 door, 2001 silver Chrysler Sebring, which has not been located.

Case reference: 2014004667.CaseDesc: On  November 25, 1999, the Gypsumville RCMP detachment received a report of an aircraft in distress over Lake Winnipeg near Reindeer Island, Manitoba. The aircraft, a single-engine Cherokee 140, was carrying three people; the pilot and two passengers. The pilot had declared that the engine had stalled and that he was trying to reach Reindeer Island. He then stated that he was going into the water. Two RCMP and an Air Search and Rescue Hercules aircrafts conducted an aerial search. It was not possible to search the lake by boat as there was too much ice on the lake. All three are presumed dead from drowning or the impact of the crash.

Case reference: 2019033665.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1988, the remains of a male were found in a field on the side of road 132 in Tracy, Québec. A camp was found near the remains.

Case reference: 2014003573.CaseDesc: On October 11, 1978, George Greyeyes left from Petersfield, Manitoba on a hunting trip. He left by canoe and was supposed to return that same day. Water conditions were poor with high winds and waves. On October 12, 1978, he had not yet returned and was reported missing to police. Searches were conducted and he was never located. George is presumed dead due to drowning.

Jacket: Nylon, Brown, Quilted plaid jacket with elbow patches

Case reference: 2018063233.CaseDesc: On March 4, 1994, at approximately 10:00pm, Stanislawa ‘Mary’ Jurkiewicz last spoke with her family. It is believed that the following morning, Mary left her residence in the area of Fern Avenue and Roncesvalles Avenue in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2017013576.CaseDesc: On December 6, 2016, Hellen Ermias and her daughter, Lina Tedros, were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. All of their personal belongings were left behind in their apartment.

Case reference: 2014005122.CaseDesc: On May 27, 2008, Phillip Morin was last seen in the Colony Street area of Winnipeg, Manitoba.

Case reference: 2021006608.CaseDesc: On July 4,2020, Anna Marquart was last seen by her husband and her sister as she walked away from her residence in Glenboro, Manitoba.

Case reference: 2012020098.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1975, at approximately 3:00 a.m., Irene Scherban was seen for the last time in front of her residence in Hudson Bay, Saskatchewan. Prior to her disappearance, Irene had attended a party.

Jewelry: Silver, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, HBCH (Hudson Bay Composite High) school insignia ring worn on each index finger
Mark: Nose, Thin red mark below bridge of nose
Chest, Round birthmark located near ribcage area

Case reference: 2012020101.CaseDesc: William Gill was last seen in the early morning hours of December 21, 1981, leaving an apartment on Appleby Drive in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. William had been out earlier that evening with a co-worker. It is very unusual for William to be out of contact with his family, particularly before Christmas.

Case reference: 2006018599.CaseDesc: Richard Rees and Gregory Cook were last seen on July 17, 1998, leaving Sunnyside Beach, Nottawasaga Bay in Meaford, Ontario in a Schwill DS16 sailboat. The overturned sailboat was recovered, but Richard and Gregory have not been located.

Mark: Upper Back, pale birthmark on right side

Case reference: 2020009588.CaseDesc: On February 8, 1989, at approximately 7:30am, Soekarmia Sarbirja was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Soekarmia was to attend an immigration hearing on February 10, but did not show up.

Case reference: 2013000094.CaseDesc: Robert Beauchamp was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on June 22, 1993. Robert left his home with friends and was never seen again.

Case reference: 2014002023.CaseDesc: Lara Brown was reported missing to the Edmonton Police Service in September 1998.  Lara was last heard from by a friend at the end of August 1998.

Case reference: 2016053812.CaseDesc: On September 11, 2016, at approximately 2:30 a.m., Van Pham was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004405.CaseDesc: John Tucsok was last seen on September 5th 2003, in Brantford, Ontario and his vehicle was later located in the Niagara Falls (ON) area. It is believed John may have travelled to western Canada or he may have crossed the border into the United States.

Case reference: 2014006556.CaseDesc: On the 23rd of July, 2006, Preston Waldner was swimming at Paradise Beach, South Saskatchewan River, when he and another fellow were attempting to swim across the river. The boys got part way across when they ran into trouble due to the very strong current of the river. The one fellow was pulled from the river and survived, however Preston was seen going under and he never resurfaced. A search was conducted but he has not been located.

Tattoo: Left Chest, Howling wolf with the initial "PWW" above the wolf

Case reference: 2020011793.CaseDesc: On October 23, 1985, Ruth Koenig was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Ruth had taken some time off from working following the death of her husband on October 18, but never returned.

Case reference: 2014002303.CaseDesc: On October 8, 1960, Herbert Lafferty was seen for the last time as he checked rabbit snares with his grandfather, just outside of Fort Resolution in the Northwest Territories. Herbert did not return from checking those snares, and some of his friends had reported that Herbert had indicated that he had made plans to rejoin his mother in British Columbia.

Case reference: 2017074237.CaseDesc: On November 17, 1999, the partial remains of an adult male were discovered in a wooded area off of Tower Road, south of the Town of Mactier, in Severn Township, Ontario.

Case reference: 2018032776.CaseDesc: On Tuesday, June 12 2018, Christian Robinson was seen for the last time leaving his home in the 6th Line and Simcoe Rd. area in the Town of Bradford, Ontario.

Backpack: May have a backpack with unknown contents
Shirt: Grey, Golf, White and yellow pattern on the chest

Case reference: 2005006599.CaseDesc:
On September 18, 1978, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Toronto Harbour of Lake Ontario. His post-mortem weight was 163lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.
Staining on his teeth suggest that he may have been a smoker. It is estimated that he had been in the water for several weeks.

Teeth: Stained, Overbite & several amalgam fillings. Several teeth lost/extracted during life; lower right lateral incisor being most obvious.
